backup.title: Back up and restore Bayplan
backup.intro: A backup holds users, teams, access, settings, environments and the audit log, and the same for anything added in later releases. It doesn't hold the master key, sessions or pending links. Keep the backup passphrase safe: Bayplan can't recover it.

download.title: Download a backup
download.failed: Couldn't create the backup. Check the container logs, then try again.
